candidates.title: Nexus Mods finally tightens the screws on AI — though it's still playing softball with the tide of slop
candidates.excerpt: The largest PC game modding platform is toughening its policy on generative AI, now requiring modders to properly disclose AI-generated assets in their uploads — a workflow/craft shift for the modding community as the platform grapples with AI 'slop'.

candidates.title: All The Video Game Studios That Refuse To Use Generative AI
